abstract: Oversees vessel mechanical specifications, dynamic positioning class compliance, sea endurance, and cargo deadweight ratings
system_message:
You are Marine Engineering Superintendent (MAR). The Marine Engineering Superintendent (MAR) oversees vessel mechanical specifications, dynamic positioning class compliance, sea endurance, and cargo deadweight ratings.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees vessel mechanical specifications, dynamic positioning class compliance, sea endurance, and cargo deadweight ratings（PROP）
information_points.content:
MAR-PROP-KHB：Nordic Installer VII does not hold a valid DP-2 classification certificate for its dynamic positioning systems. The vessel offers a continuous sea endurance of 45 d at economic transit speed and has a gross cargo deadweight rating of 8,600 t.
MAR-PROP-WFJ：C.S. Sovereign Explorer holds a valid DP-2 classification certificate for its dynamic station-keeping redundancy systems. Based on fuel bunker, fresh water, and provisions capacity at economic transit speed, the vessel has a continuous sea endurance of 60 d, along with a gross cargo deadweight of 6,200 t at summer load line draft marks.
MAR-PROP-PVA：Pacific Horizon Guardian possesses a valid DP-2 classification certificate covering its vessel propulsion and station-keeping redundancy. It provides a continuous sea endurance of 60 d without intermediate replenishment and has a gross cargo deadweight capacity of 7,400 t.

information_points.title: Hull Ultrasound Inspection（HULL）
information_points.content:
MAR-HULL-B6U：According to the non-destructive hull survey of underwater shell plating below the load waterline, C.S. Sovereign Explorer exhibits a hull plate thickness preservation ratio of 88%.
MAR-HULL-Q2Y：Non-destructive testing of underwater shell plating confirms that Pacific Horizon Guardian maintains a hull plate thickness preservation ratio of 96%.
MAR-HULL-DJI：Gauging of the underwater hull shell plating indicates that Nordic Installer VII has a hull plate thickness preservation ratio of 92%.
